start.title: Match your baskets to what matters to you
start.text: Until you complete the Sustainable Food Compass, your baskets are matched against an expert weighting, not your own priorities.

firstAttempt.title: Finish the compass to match your baskets to your priorities
firstAttempt.text: Until you complete it, your baskets are matched against an expert weighting, not your own priorities.

retake.title: Finish the compass to update your priorities
retake.text: Until you complete it, your baskets are matched against the priorities you gave last time.

xp.title: XP
xp.ahead: Ahead of {{share, number(style: percent)}} of shoppers
xp.earning: You earn {{xp, number}} XP for each product you buy that scores high for sustainability, and a bonus when a whole basket scores well.
xp.compared: The shoppers you are compared with are everyone who has bought at least once, at any shop that uses HowiBuy.
xp.rule: Earn {{xp, number}} XP for each product that scores high for sustainability, and a bonus when a whole basket scores well.

streak.title: Streak
streak.earning: A basket keeps your streak going when at least one of its products scores high for sustainability. A basket without one starts the count again.
streak.rule: Buy a product that scores high for sustainability in every basket to keep a streak going.

badges.title: Badges
badges.rule: Earn one for {{first, number}}, {{second, number}} and {{third, number}} products that score high in one dimension.
badges.text: Each badge counts the products you buy that score high in its dimension, every time you buy them.

empty.title: Your first purchase starts the count
empty.text: Every purchase your shop registers with HowiBuy adds to this page.

month.title: This month
month.text: The average score, from 0 to 1, of the products you bought, per dimension.
month.nothingThisMonth: Nothing bought yet in {{current}}. {{previous}}’s averages stay here until your first purchase this month.
month.nothingLastMonth: You bought nothing in {{previous}}, so there is no change to show yet.
month.nothingEither: Nothing bought in {{previous}}, nor yet in {{current}}.
month.firstPurchase: Each month’s averages show here from your first purchase.
month.footnote: Bar: {{current}} so far. Tick: {{previous}}. A purchase counts in the month of its date.
